scenarios.plan: Bias up but if retail is crowded long, expect 'sell-on-rise / dip-then-recover': a dip into 24600 that reverses up is the high-probability path.

Ideal for a long setup if Smart Money is bullish. Market likely digs toward support 24600 (may even SWEEP liquidity just below a round figure to grab retail stop-losses), then REVERSES up — that liquidity sweep + institutional level + psychological level = high-probability long confluence. A sustained close BELOW 24600 with bearish volume flips it to resistance → continuation DOWN.
Trade the band: buy dips into support 24600 (hold → bounce), sell rallies into resistance 25150 (reject → fade). Direction resolves on which wall breaks with follow-through.
Watch resistance 25150. Rejection → fade back toward 24600. A decisive 15-min close ABOVE 25150 (call writers unwinding) → breakout continuation UP toward the next call wall.
